basic_info.description: The homes at 2813 - 2815 19th Street offer premium San Francisco living. Featuring an Eastlake-Stick-Victorian faade, two spacious vacant flats, and light-filled interiors, this property impresses. Residence 2813, the lower floor, has approximately 1,030 sq.ft. with 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, and two gas fireplaces. Residence 2815, the top floor, has approximately 1,195 sq.ft., 1-2 bedrooms, and 1 bathroom. Additionally, there is a 460 sq.ft. bonus room with a luxurious bathroom and separate entrance.  Both homes feature period detailing, high ceilings, modern kitchens, and bathrooms. The top-floor home includes multiple skylights and a spa-like bathroom with Waterworks fixtures, heated floors, a towel rack, and beautiful tilework.  This building is ideal for both investors and owner-users, boasting updated systems, double-pane windows, structural improvements, and tandem parking for up to 2 cars.
